results.question: We are quoting the complete assembly (piping, isolation valve, elastomer seal, flange bolting kit, and actuator) for Manifold Loop B at the Borealis facility operating at 120 PSI during winter conditions (-42°C). Which exact part SKUs are required?
results.expected_answer: For Manifold Loop B at -42°C and 120 PSI, the required SKUs are piping #PIPE-PEX9-ARC (or ASTM A333 Grade 6), Cryogenic Trunnion Valve #VLV-200-LT, Ultra-Low-Temp FFKM Seal #SEAL-FFKM-ULT90, low-temperature bolting kit #BOLT-L7-L4, and High-Torque Hydraulic Actuator #ACT-HYD-350.

Selecting PIPE-PEX9-ARC without listing the permitted ASTM A333 Grade 6 alternative is sufficient. Minor issues are the additional DS-04 requirement, which is not established by the reference, and an isolated BOLT-L7-4 typo in the rejected-parts discussion; the main bill of materials and final quote give the correct bolting SKU.

results.question: What isolation valve body, elastomer seal, flange bolt kit, and actuator SKU are required for Manifold Loop A (Glycol Return, 110 PSI) at the Borealis facility during winter shutdown (-42°C)?
results.expected_answer: Manifold Loop A does not receive methanol injection (SEC-3.2), so it is subject to Cryogenic Excursion (SEC-4.3 / SEC-4.4) without the Polar-Solvent override. It requires standard valve body #VLV-200-SS fitted with Low-Temp Fluorosilicone seal #SEAL-FVMQ-40, low-temp bolt kit #BOLT-L7-L4, and baseline pneumatic actuator #ACT-PN-100.

verdict.judge_rationale: The candidate correctly identifies the absence of methanol and names VLV-200-SS, SEAL-FVMQ-40, and BOLT-L7-L4. However, it also approves a conflicting cryogenic-body/FFKM configuration and explicitly prohibits ACT-PN-100, contradicting the reference requirement to retain that baseline pneumatic actuator. Its conclusion that the assembly is unresolved fails to provide the clear, required four-SKU selection.
failure_reasons: Incorrectly prohibits the required baseline pneumatic actuator ACT-PN-100.
Introduces VLV-200-LT, SEAL-FFKM-ULT90, and ACT-HYD-350 through overrides that do not apply to Loop A's non-methanol service.
Presents contradictory valve and seal requirements and declares the BOM unresolved instead of specifying the required standard-body/FVMQ assembly.

However, Zone-A3 (-42°C) still triggers SEC-4.3 for bolting and seals, requiring bolt kit #BOLT-L7-L4 and Fluorosilicone seal #SEAL-FVMQ-40 inside valve #VLV-200-SS.

results.expected_answer: Because ambient temperature (-20°C) is below -15°C, Automated Chemical Dosing Skid #DS-04 injects 8.0% anhydrous methanol into Manifold Loop B (SEC-3.2), classifying it as a Polar-Solvent Service Line (SEC-3.3). results.question: Why is pneumatic actuator #ACT-PN-100 prohibited on Manifold Loop B during winter operations, and what exact torque value and replacement SKU are mandated?
results.expected_answer: Manifold Loop B requires seal #SEAL-FFKM-ULT90 inside valve #VLV-200-LT (per SEC-4.5). Under SEC-5.1, #SEAL-FFKM-ULT90 increases stem breakaway torque by 185% at -40°C to 215 Nm. Because #ACT-PN-100 is only rated for 120 Nm, it will stall during emergency shutdown, so SEC-5.2 mandates High-Torque Hydraulic Actuator #ACT-HYD-350 (rated to 400 Nm).

results.question: Why is pneumatic actuator #ACT-PN-100 prohibited on Manifold Loop B during winter operations, and what exact torque value and replacement SKU are mandated?
results.expected_answer: Manifold Loop B requires seal #SEAL-FFKM-ULT90 inside valve #VLV-200-LT (per SEC-4.5). Under SEC-5.1, #SEAL-FFKM-ULT90 increases stem breakaway torque by 185% at -40°C to 215 Nm. Because #ACT-PN-100 is only rated for 120 Nm, it will stall during emergency shutdown, so SEC-5.2 mandates High-Torque Hydraulic Actuator #ACT-HYD-350 (rated to 400 Nm).
